findings.resolution: Separate install and wheel options; static exact-pinned CLI contract regression.

findings.issue: Named requirement source lives under pip-wheel-*/progressbar_UUID, not pip-req-build-*
findings.resolution: Owned pip unpack hook captures and validates the exact actual named source location before metadata execution.

findings.issue: Lexical .. cancellation precedes POSIX symlink resolution
findings.resolution: Explicitly reject nonleading .. targets, validate final chains on canonical output nodes, and reject file targets with directory suffixes.

findings.issue: No production before-source snapshot or retained per-file before/after maps
findings.resolution: Owned offline build hook validates the actual unpacked tree before first source execution, retains full bounded before/after manifests and actual workspace.

findings.issue: Remote /tmp downloads/partial roots and tmpfs working tree would disappear without retained artifact
findings.resolution: Primary host creates one hard-quota256MiB tmpfs accessible through a fixed passed FD; retain bounded exact workspace archive and inventory on success/failure.
